name: Merzouga
blurb: Merzouga has appeared in travel conversation only in the last few weeks, from a base of almost nothing. Early posts are enthusiastic but the sample is still small.

positive: Good value compared with last year
Food repeatedly singled out as a highlight
negative: Some report crowding at peak times
Cheap accommodation getting harder to find

quotes.text: Prices have crept up but it is still cheaper than the mainland.
Spent a week here working remotely, wifi was fine everywhere.
The food alone would be worth the trip.
